description.value:
You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits:

  • Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of your current Ability Score Maximum.
  • You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice. Each one must be a simple or a martial weapon.

system.requirements: You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice. Each one must be a simple or a martial weapon.
